questions.prompt: Match each function term to its meaning.
questions.explanation: Parameters define the contract, arguments supply actual inputs, and the return value is the call result.

questions.prompt: Which function design is easiest to reuse for a business rule?
options: Read console input inside the rule

questions.prompt: What readability problem exists in formatExpense(value, true, false)?
questions.answer: The Boolean arguments do not reveal which parameters they control
questions.explanation: Named arguments or a clearer model make Boolean configuration understandable at the call site.
